description: Land Title Settlement Department - Katukurunda, Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District and other property of Intestate notices
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including village names, cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The content focuses on land title registration procedures for deceased persons' properties, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
